reason: Permit peer CLI runtime writes within the parent sandbox.
insert:
;; Runtime grants apply to every process in the enclosing session.
(define (peer-home s) (string-append (param "HOME") s))
(allow file-write*
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/tmp"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/.tmp"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/sessions"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/log"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/sqlite"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/thread-writer-locks"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.codex/model-catalogs"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.codex/installation_id"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.codex/models_cache.json"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.codex/session_index.jsonl"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.codex/.sqlite-maintenance.lock"))
  (require-all (subpath (peer-home "/.codex"))
    (regex #"/[^/]+_[0-9]+\\.sqlite(-wal|-shm)?$"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/debug"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/projects"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/sessions"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/todos"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/file-history"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/paste-cache"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.claude/cache"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.claude/history.jsonl"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.cursor/chats"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.cursor/projects"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.cursor/ai-tracking"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.cursor/agent-cli-state.json"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.grok/sessions"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.grok/logs"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.grok/projects"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.grok/memory"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.grok/memory-v2"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.grok/.config-init.lock"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.grok/active_sessions.json"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.grok/active_sessions.lock"))
  (literal (peer-home "/.grok/models_cache.json"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.local/share/opencode"))
  (subpath (peer-home "/.local/state/opencode")))
